1. k-43 straight-line kitchen made to individual dimensions for bratislava and vienna

parts.html: The K-43 kitchen model is a contemporary straight-line composition defined by contrast in both color and texture. The lower cabinets and tall side units are finished in a deep dark burgundy, wine-like shade. The central upper row is dark graphite and features a pronounced vertical ribbed texture, making the kitchen visually distinctive and architectural in character.

The key design feature of K-43 is the contrast between the smooth burgundy surfaces and the textured graphite upper section. The burgundy finish adds depth and warmth, while the graphite ribbed upper row forms a strong horizontal accent across the working area.

The working zone is finished in a unified dark palette. The countertop appears black or very dark, and the backsplash continues the same visual language, creating a solid dark backdrop for the entire preparation area.

The interior visualization clearly shows a tall dark burgundy unit with a built-in oven on the left, as well as another tall closed unit on the right in the same finish. Between them is the main working line of the kitchen with lower cabinetry and the graphite upper section.
Layout and dimensions

K-43 has a straight-line configuration. The full kitchen composition is arranged along one wall, making the model suitable for contemporary apartments, private residences, and open-plan living spaces.
The kitchen has a total linear length of 4.1 meters. The standard dimensions are 4.1 × 2.4 × 0.6 m.

This layout allows storage, the working surface, built-in appliances, and tall units to be integrated into one continuous line. During individual planning, the sink, cooktop, appliance placement, and internal storage systems can be adapted to the room layout and service connections.

The model is designed for built-in appliances. This means the furniture is planned to accommodate integrated equipment, but the appliances themselves are not automatically included in the standard furniture package.
A separate kitchen island is not included in the standard specification.
Materials and finishes

The upper and lower cabinet fronts are made from laminated particleboard. According to the technical card, the base color is described as red, but the supplied visualizations show a more refined composition with dark burgundy lower sections and a graphite upper row.

The lower cabinets and both tall side units are finished in a deep wine-dark burgundy tone. The central upper fronts are dark graphite and feature a vertical ribbed texture, which is one of the key decorative features of the model.
The cabinet structure is made from 18 mm laminated particleboard.
The countertop is chipboard-based. In the visualization it has a very dark, almost black appearance. The backsplash follows the same dark palette and visually extends the worktop.

Although the base specification describes the decor as solid color, the visual identity of the kitchen is defined not only by color but also by texture contrast: smooth burgundy surfaces are combined with a ribbed graphite upper section.
Hardware and functionality
The standard K-43 specification includes Hettich hinges with soft-close, providing smooth and controlled closing of hinged cabinet doors.
Pull-out elements use Quadro Hettich concealed runners, supporting a clean and minimal interior appearance.
Cargo storage is not included in the standard specification.
Lift mechanisms are not included.

According to the technical specification, handles are included, although the visualization presents the cabinetry in a very clean, minimalist manner with emphasis on horizontal dark profile divisions between the cabinet rows.
Optional upgrades
Upon request, K-43 can be equipped with more functional furniture hardware, alternative opening mechanisms, and additional internal storage solutions.

The kitchen can also be manufactured using alternative materials, ranging from budget-friendly to premium options. The level of hardware, front materials, countertop, and internal fittings can all be selected individually.
These features are optional upgrades and are not part of the standard K-43 configuration.

Custom K-43 kitchens in Bratislava and Vienna
DUMSKAYA DESIGN, based in Bratislava, Slovakia, provides custom kitchen design and manufacturing services for apartments, private residences, and interior projects in Bratislava and Vienna.

The K-43 model can be adapted to the specific room dimensions, with adjustments to the overall length, built-in appliance placement, internal storage, and finishing materials. Clients can choose alternative front colors, a different level of hardware, another countertop solution, and additional functional upgrades.

Our services include furniture design, material and hardware selection, manufacturing, delivery, and professional installation. Upon request, we can also assist with the selection of sinks, taps, extractor hoods, and household appliances.
